description: Stop Serve/Funnel shares: one mount, the shares this server created, or all of them, reporting what was removed. Name exactly one target: httpsPort and/or path turns off that one mount (httpsPort is the serve port shown in share_status, typically 443, not the proxied local port; path is the mount path given to share_port, default "/"); mine=true stops only the shares this server created in this session; all=true clears the entire serve/funnel configuration, including shares set up outside this server. With no arguments nothing is stopped and the active endpoints are listed. Returns what was removed and what remains.

all.description: Clear the ENTIRE serve/funnel config, including shares not created by this server

httpsPort.description: HTTPS serve port of the mount to turn off (default 443 when path is given)

mine.description: Stop only the shares created by share_port in this session

path.description: Mount path to turn off, as passed to share_port (default: "/")

name: stop_share

publicExposure.description: True when any endpoint is exposed via Funnel; null if unknown (old CLI)

status.description: Raw text status, only on CLIs without --json

title: Stop sharing
